text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Once again this year, the time for 
Tracen Academy's traditional Fan 
Appreciation Festival is fast 
approaching."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In normal years, the academy would open 
its gates to welcome countless fans for a 
massive sports-day-style event, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was officially announced that this 
year's event would primarily be held 
online via livestream to prevent the 
spread of infection...

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Thanksgiving Festival is coming up soon!" 
"I really wanted to see everyone~" "I 
can't believe it's online only..." "So sad 
;;" "Well, under the circumstances it 
can't be helped" "Tough times~"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. It's a shame we lost 
another chance for everyone to see us in 
person. But—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how excited everyone is gets me all 
fired up too♪ I'll do my absolute best on 
the big day, so be sure to cheer for me on 
stream♡

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"So hyped!" "Cheering for you big time!" 
"Waiting on standby right now!" "Let's do 
this!" "Watching it live~~!" "Can't 
wait~!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu. Everyone looks so happy♪ Even with 
the outbreak, it looks like the community 
is doing fine.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me, Koya-Dofu-san and the 
others always go to the Fan Appreciation 
Festival every year! I wonder if they'll 
be watching the livestream in real time 
today?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"......Huh? Looks like Kouya Dofu-san 
isn't here today. I thought they were 
always here around this time, though—"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Now that you mention it, they're not 
here." "That's unusual." "Their bio said 
on hiatus for a bit." "Sign of the times, 
maybe?" "Anyone know what's up?"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Comment
text_block_list.text:
"‘I heard recently that the shop they run 
is having a hard time because customers 
dropped off due to an infection. They 
might not be able to come for a while.’"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Right, of course. Everyone's going 
through... a lot right now... aren't 
they...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I'd like to say this once again: I want 
everyone to take care of yourselves first 
and put your health above all else.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Nothing makes me happier than seeing 
everyone in high spirits! ♪

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Her kindness warms my heart." "You too, 
Loves-chan!" "Damn you, infection!" 
"Health comes first!" "So painful..." 
"Seriously, what a harsh world we live 
in." "Hang in there~"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer-kun. During that stream just 
now, I noticed something―"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan. During the stream just 
now, I realized something—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...It seems the outbreak is affecting our 
community members as well...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Regulars who always came to my streams 
stopped showing up... and even the people 
here now seem to be going through a tough 
time—
choice_data_list: ...I felt a bit of that as well.
...I had felt that a little, too.

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"No, seriously, my job's totally ruined 
too. Every event we had scheduled got 
wiped out. Everyone on the ground and the 
higher-ups are completely overwhelmed..."

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
"Overseas is in total chaos right now, 
too. Seriously, how long is this situation 
gonna last...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even in recent exchanges with comm 
members, the number of people reporting 
changes in their lives due to the 
infectious disease was growing day by day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It seems this situation is also beginning 
to affect the viewership and viewer 
retention of Loves Only You's streams..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that makes sense after all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Then this time, it's my turn to cheer up 
the committee members!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I mean, isn't it? Everyone in Dubai gave 
me so much encouragement♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...When the race got canceled back then, 
I thought the members of our community 
must be feeling really down."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's why I thought 'I need to cheer them 
up,' and 'I have to show them I'm full of 
energy so they won't worry'—even though I 
felt that way...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
On the contrary... I was the one who got 
encouraged. Everyone gave me so many warm 
words...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Next is my turn. If everyone is suffering, 
I want to do whatever I can to encourage 
their hearts...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So I'm totally fired up for the Fan 
Thanksgiving! As a fellow streamer, I'm 
definitely gonna make this online event a 
huge success!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so our community members can feel even 
a little bit better right now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so Loves Only You became fired up 
for the Fan Appreciation Festival—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, the day arrived.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it, but... It really is lonely 
when there's nobody around...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even with the atmosphere of past years 
recreated like this... not having any fans 
here... is really tough, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Come on, both of you, don't make those 
faces—smile more♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand completely how lonely you 
must feel. But all the fans who couldn't 
make it here today must feel the exact 
same way."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone watching the stream is here to 
see us doing our best with bright energy. 
Keep smiling♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because we share those same 
feelings— that we must send out our love 
and cheer them on! That will surely reach 
everyone watching...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Loves-san—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. Now is our time to 
blossom."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Love-chan! Thanks to you, I was 
able to shift gears a full 120 miles!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh♪ By the way, here's some advice 
from me as a fellow streamer—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Instead of vaguely imagining the viewers 
beyond the camera, picture them 
concretely. It'll make them feel more real 
to you and get you motivated♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
For instance, someone relaxing in a cozy 
spot, casually watching the stream while 
looking forward to seeing their favorite 
idol shine—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It might be a little tough right now, but 
to all the people watching the stream with 
friends while talking about their 
favorites—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
There might even be cases where the whole 
family gathers in the living room to enjoy 
the stream together♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Like this, I try to imagine all the 
people watching from the other side of the 
camera.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"When you do that, you become conscious of 
the people watching over you even if they 
aren't right here, and that 'Let's do 
this!' feeling grows stronger♡"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see, imagine what's on the other side of 
the camera...! That's great! I'll try it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"That method is so typical of Love-chan... 
I will try picturing my fans too."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad it was helpful♪ Let's get 
everyone pumped up today and put on a 
great show for all the fans watching 
through the camera!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
...Now, the chaotic steeplechase finally 
enters its final stretch!! Loves Only You 
makes her move all at once here--!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Loves Only You sweeps past the field! She 
crosses the finish line in 1st place!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Fufu, yay!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for all the support, everyone 
watching the stream♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm just as full of love today as when I'm 
racing, so keep your eyes on me after 
this, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Loves Only You is so fired up and 
gives great fan service~...! Now that's 
someone worth cheering for...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The number of dropouts is piling up 
fast!! In this grueling endurance dance 
battle, which Umamusume will dance with 
brilliance until the very end?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Gaaaaah, this is ridiculously touuuugh!! 
But—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me, everyone! Because 
today, I'm gonna dance the loveliest of 
all!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Go for it, Loves Only You!" "Thanks for 
the shoutout!" "Appreciate the glance!" 
"We're watching~~!!" "She's my fave."

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer B
text_block_list.text:
Whaat, this Loves Only You girl has such a 
wonderful smile...! I think I just found 
another fave...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Loves Only You tackled the Fan 
Appreciation Festival with everything she 
had for her livestream viewers—

text_block_list.name: Fan's Comment
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad I watched the Thanksgiving 
Festival~!" "It gave me so much energy!" 
"Thank you for streaming it!" "I'm really 
grateful to be able to watch something 
like this right now."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Precisely because times are tough 
right now, seeing us give it our all can 
really encourage people, can't it?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to be weak, not now...! 
Next time, in the race... I have to do 
even better...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Loves Only You gave her all at the 
Fan Appreciation Festival for everyone 
watching the livestream—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Great work at the Fan Appreciation 
Festival~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I checked earlier, and your stream's 
concurrent viewer count looked amazing! 
The total views were incredible too—
choice_data_list:
Looks like it exceeded even the academy's 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Is that so! Hehe♪ I'm glad I could be of 
some help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I show Loves Only You the impressions and 
feedback from today's Fan Appreciation 
Festival that I had looked up beforehand—

text_block_list.name: Impression Comment
text_block_list.text:
"The way Loves Only You called out to the 
camera over and over during the race was 
so deeply touching. I can't help falling 
in love with her."

text_block_list.name: Impression Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone was so full of energy, it really 
gave me a boost! Especially Loves Only 
You-chan's smile, it's the best! Thanks 
for all the love~!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness—
choice_data_list: Everyone in the community was happy too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ I'll ask for everyone's thoughts on 
that during my stream♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, Loves Only You's Fan 
Appreciation Festival concluded, bringing 
energy to the hearts of many.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...Now I realize it even more. Precisely 
because everyone's struggling right now, 
there's something I can do.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to be weak, not now...! 
Next time, in the race... I have to do 
even better...!
